description: Sentinel-1 IW dual-pol (VV/VH) clips, CONTEXT box (lon -114.245..-114.060, lat 50.975..51.112), EPSG:32611 10 m grid x 692820-706410, y 5650650-5666400. One folder per acquisition date (all ascending; relative orbits 20 and 122; S1C/S1D; nothing before 2025-04-01 over this AOI). grd_vv/grd_vh = GRD amplitude DN (uint16, not calibrated, not terrain-corrected); rtc_vv/rtc_vh = Planetary Computer RTC gamma0 linear power (float32). Clipped server-side by Planetary Computer data API. 4 dates (2026-04-21, -04-26, -05-03, -05-08) have STAC only (Earth Search lists them; bytes requester-pays and unreachable). 2026-02-19 has RTC only.
